notes.title: Minor Update d.0.4.20250922
notes.notes:
September 22, 2025 Update Content:

1. Added integration with Steam's cloud save feature.

2. Menus now display the quantity of each relevant ingredient.

3. You can now hide items from the alternative menu.

4. Beating customers no longer deducts money.

5. Special bricks in the research mini-game no longer swallow cannonballs.

6. Fixed some translation issues.

notes.title: Minor Update d.0.4.20250919
notes.notes:
September 19, 2025 Update Content:

1. Fixed an issue where the game wouldn't run properly on German systems.

2. Added domed plastic cups and differentiated which cups could be added to the top.

3. Fixed an issue where the liquid in the cup disappeared after adding ice cubes when making milk tea in the main scene.

4. Added a more detailed tutorial for beginners to the milk tea research mini-game.

5. Fixed an issue where wallpaper would stick to the other side of the wall.

6. When ordering, customers could ask for recommendations for milk teas they couldn't currently order. This issue has been fixed.

7. Expired food can no longer be combined with food that hasn't expired yet.

8. Added 800 yuan to the initial funds awarded to players in the level 5 shop renovation quest.

9. Adjusted the models of dried taro balls and oolong tea.

10. Rewards from reward boxes are now divided into different levels.

11. Blueprints can now be saved and loaded normally.

12. Fixed the issue where a window could not detect the wall when it was too close to other windows.

notes.title: Minor Update d.0.4.20250912
notes.notes:
September 12, 2025 Update Content:

1. Modified the purchasing UI panel.

2. Changed the milk tea pricing method to a proportional price increase.

3. Fixed an issue where the mouth slider wouldn't drag when creating a face in 4K resolution.

4. Modified the reward box opening and draw effects.

5. Fixed an issue where random female clothing clipped through the model.

6. Fixed an issue where a cat would float in the air after removing a table while it was on top.

notes.title: Minor Update d.0.4.20250908
notes.notes:
September 8, 2025 Update Content:

1. Added the ability to send your uncle to explore the map (available in the official version).

2. Added the ability to recruit employees (available in the official version).

3. Fixed an issue where the notification "Cannot Recruit" appeared when refilling an ice cream cup after emptying it.

4. Increased the number of customers per day.

5. Adjusted the customer refresh interval to update customers based on the player's average serving time.

6. Adjusted the font order of store signs so that text on signs no longer extends beyond the model.

7. Adjusted the order of dialog boxes above the character's head to prevent overlapping UI elements.

8. Adjusted the lighting angle to reduce glare on the desktop during daytime.

notes.title: Minor Update d.0.4.20250901
notes.notes:
September 1, 2025 Update Content:

1. Fixed an issue where, after expanding a shop, the surrounding stall models would not refresh when loading a save, occupying the expanded area.

2. You can no longer feed a sleeping cat.

3. To ensure the tutorial works properly, construction mode must be enabled on the third day.

4. You can no longer successfully sell to customers who leave after the timeout.

5. Added a reset player position button to the menu screen to reset the player if they are stuck.

6. Fixed a bug where the pre-save price of an item was retained after loading a save, but the item was not recorded. Loading a save now resets the ordering interface.

7. Fixed an issue where pots could not be placed on the stove.

8. Fixed an issue where loading a save during the Uncle Er Recommends Milk Tea tutorial would cause the game to freeze.

9. Feeding a sleeping cat is no longer allowed.

10. Fixed an issue where, after loading a save after expanding a shop, the neighboring shop model would revert to its pre-expansion state.

11. Fixed an issue where walls and wallpapers could not be switched in Build Mode.

notes.title: Minor Update d.0.4.20250829
notes.notes:
Updated on August 29, 2025:

1. Fixed an issue where pearls in the condiment counter could not be merged. This issue will no longer occur when re-building the condiment counter.

2. Fixed an issue where the game could not automatically save on some devices.

3. Changed the shop expansion method to: each expansion only adds 1 meter of length and width, reducing the cost of each expansion.

4. To make it easier for players to build walls, the shop construction task has been modified and guidance for expansion areas has been added.

5. Changed the logic of the patience bar when customers are waiting to order. Customers now have to go to their respective positions in the queue before their patience is reduced.

6. Changed the pathfinding logic. Automatic pathfinding is now less likely to go to the other side of the table.

7. Initially added the "Second Uncle" outing exploration feature, which will unlock at shop level 6.

notes.title: Minor Update d.0.3.20250806
notes.notes:
Updated on August 6, 2025:

1. Changed the default control method: left-click for interaction, right-click for camera rotation, and scroll wheel for inventory switching.

2. Adjusted the game's camera perspective and some control details.

3. Adjusted the stall table when starting a new game.

4. Adjusted the interval between customers on the first day; it will now be shorter, allowing customers to arrive more quickly.

5. Fixed some issues that could cause the game to freeze.

6. Adjusted some UI effects, adjusted some font sizes, and added more UI effects.

7. Fixed an issue where rooms could not be recognized.

8. Improved game save speed after daily settlement.

9. Adjusted the daily settlement UI and confirm button.

10. Adjusted the lighting effects at night.

notes.title: Minor Update d.0.3.20250715
notes.notes:
Update content on July 15, 2025:

1. The cat model has been replaced, and the cat has developed limited autonomous action capabilities.

2. The characteristics of researching milk tea skills have been developed. Now after the skills of researching milk tea are upgraded, skill points will be obtained, which can be used to unlock characteristics and be used in the mini-game of researching milk tea.

3. The problem that some construction items cannot be undone has been fixed.

4. The portraits of Uncle Er, Boss Zhang, and the cat have been redrawn.

5. Some UI effects have been adjusted.

6. More milk tea shop icons have been added.

7. Some classic milk tea portraits have been modified.

notes.title: Minor Update d.0.3.20250707
notes.notes:
Update content on July 7, 2025:

1. When researching milk tea, a pop-up panel comparing the old and new values ​​is added after upgrading the old milk tea.

2. The UI icons of all raw materials are completed.

3. The problem of customers being generated directly in the store is fixed.

4. The taste score of spoiled milk tea is now 0.

5. Now all tasks related to the second uncle are not allowed to be triggered during the store opening process.

6. The collision logic of decorations has been modified, and decorations are no longer allowed to overlap.

7. The problem of not returning money after using the floor removal tool to remove the floor has been fixed.

8. The problem that the cleaning animation can still continue when switching items in hand while sweeping garbage has been fixed.

9. Some text translation errors have been fixed.

10. Cat beds are no longer allowed to be built on shelves or tables, and tables are no longer allowed to be stacked on each other.

11. Customers who have already purchased milk tea on the same day cannot be successfully promoted again.

12. The logic of checking the closure of the store has been added. If the store funds are negative for 3 consecutive days, it will be closed.

notes.title: Minor Update d.0.3.20250702
notes.notes:
Update content on July 2, 2025:

1. Adjusted the price of spoiled milk tea and garbage. Now it costs money to remove them in building mode.

2. Adjusted the feel of rotating the camera with the middle mouse button.

3. When the player approaches the surrounding shops, the shop model will be hidden to prevent blocking the camera.

4. Slightly increased the probability of customers buying cold drinks in summer.

5. The milk tea menu will calculate how many cups of corresponding milk tea can be made with the raw materials in the store. When ordering raw materials, the raw materials used by the milk tea that has been put on the shelf will be marked.

6. Now you can see the detailed information of the quarterly tax by hovering the mouse over it.

7. Update the UI pictures of some products in the store.

notes.title: Minor Update d.0.3.20250628
notes.notes:
Update content on June 28, 2025:

Attention! After this update, players who are not using the Steam version will no longer be able to play content after level 6!

1. The cooked ingredients will now go bad, and the ingredients put into the cup will also go bad.

2. If the pot is cooked for too long, the pearls will be burnt.

3. The mini-game effect when researching milk tea has been adjusted, and the value source of the milk tea will now be displayed during the game.

4. The problem of items floating in the air after moving the table has been fixed.

5. The problem that after canceling the construction, the money was refunded but the furniture did not disappear has been fixed.

6. In the game instructions and collection interface, you can see the information of all the recipes you have researched now.

7. The problem that the liquid model will flash when switching cups during the research of milk tea has been fixed.

8. The problem of the wrong holding position of the item when there is only one item left in the hand has been fixed.

9. The problem that the last item in the hand cannot be taken out from the shelf after it is placed on the shelf has been fixed.

10. In the first day's guidance mission, if the player adds coconut flakes when making Uncle Er's milk tea, a prompt will appear to tell him not to add coconut flakes.

11. Adjusted the effects of some UI materials.

notes.title: Minor Update d.0.3.20250621
notes.notes:
Update content on June 21, 2025:

1. Fixed the problem that the shop cannot be opened due to too many or too few pop-up menu columns on the right.

2. Added a function that the pop-up details panel will be fixed after 1.5 seconds after the mouse hovers over the item icon, so that players can view the ingredients.

3. Fixed the problem that after the player puts the window into the warehouse, the hole in the wall with the window part is still not filled back.

4. When clicking the button to pay off the loan, a confirmation step is added to prevent misclicking.

5. Added the operation of putting a portion of pearls directly from the pot into the cup.

6. At the request of players, the 3D busts of the player himself and non-task NPCs are no longer displayed during the dialogue.

7. Fixed the animation error when the male character uses a broom to clean up the garbage.

8. The number of stacks of items is displayed at the mouse pointer and the details panel of the selected item.

9. Fixed the problem of the model expanding when the ice cream is placed in the milk tea cup.

10. The file loading rules have been modified. Previously, archives of different major versions could not read each other, but now they will try to read each other.

11.Fixed the issue of incorrect deduction when changing floor texture and the issue of being unable to undo the operation of changing floor texture.

notes.title: Minor Update d.0.3.20250617
notes.notes:
Update content on June 17, 2025:



Note: Incompatible with old archives, reading old version archives may not work properly.



1. The task process has been readjusted and more detailed task guidance has been added.

2. Story dialogues have been added to all task-related characters.

3. The UI panel has been re-optimized and the art effects of all UIs have been adjusted on a large scale.

4. The visual performance of the milk tea research interface has been adjusted, and all the raw materials used in the research of milk tea have been completed.

5. The gameplay of researching milk tea has been added with the selection of drink temperature and top ingredients.

6. The UI interface of the purchase panel has been adjusted, and the operation method of purchase has been reorganized.

7. Now each season has been adjusted to 7 days, and there are 28 days a year.

8. The gameplay of peak traffic has been added. There will be peaks on the fifth, sixth and seventh days of each season.

9. The character's standby animation has been added. When the character is not operated for a long time, the character will randomly play the standby animation.

notes.title: Minor Update V.0.1.20250412
notes.notes:
Update content on April 12, 2025:

New content:
1. The description of the task panel has been refined, and the completed operations will be checked.
2. The function of talking to the second uncle has been added. You can trigger the plot dialogue with the second uncle during the task.
3. The function of displaying NPC avatars on the UI has been developed.
4. Some hand-painted UI item icons have been added.

Fixed issues and content adjustments:
1. Fixed the scaling issues of some UIs at different resolutions.
2. Adjusted the viewing distance during third-person operation.
3. Adjusted the process of some tasks.
4. Fixed some text translation errors.
5. Fixed the issue that the shelf items were suspended in the original place after the shelf was put into inventory.
6. Fixed the issue that the carpet would be blocked by furniture when building a carpet.
7. Fixed the issue that every time an item is unlocked, the unlocked item prompt panel repeatedly prompts the unlocked item. Now each item will only be prompted once, and will not be prompted again later.

notes.title: Minor Update V.0.1.20250331
notes.notes:
Updated on 31 March 2025:

What's new:
1. Added the function of using refrigerator to make custard.
2. Developed the character's bathroom interaction.
3. The process of making ice cream using ice cream mechanism was developed.

Fix issues and content adjustments:
1. The lighting effect of the research milk tea scene was adjusted.
2. Adjusted the flow of some tasks.

notes.title: Minor Update V.0.1.20250228
notes.notes:
Updated on February 28, 2025:

What's new:
1. The explosion panel of classic milk tea was added.
2. Added the collection of illustrations, and added a dozen kinds of classic milk tea hand-painted illustrations.
3. Added a random standby action for the protagonist when there is no action.

Fix issues and content adjustments:
1. A table with a ceiling will automatically hide the ceiling when the mouse moves to the table position.
2. Fixed some furniture model problems.

notes.title: Minor Update V.0.1.20250214
notes.notes:
Updated on 14 February 2025:

Fix issues and content adjustments:
1. Fixed multiple customers sitting on chairs overlapping each other.
2. Fixed an issue where the mouse needed to click twice to interact with items after entering the game.
3. Fixed incorrect out-of-order listing issue.

notes.title: Minor Update V.0.1.20250210
notes.notes:
Updated on 10 February 2025:

What's new:
1. Added the occlusion prompt when the interactive position of furniture is blocked by other furniture and cannot be reached.
2. Modified the opening booth and reduced some furniture.
3. With the function of active goods, goods with corresponding labels can be used as active goods.

Fix issues and content adjustments:
1. Fixed an issue where some UI entries were too large or too small at different resolutions.
